items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but starting him everywhere as they wouldn't activate if overly concerned; some Cardinals risk remains.
items.why: Ankle sprain; expected to play per beat/sources; confirmed active.
items.implication: Start as RB2/flex with upside but monitor early snaps/workload split.
items.opportunity: Early-down and potential goal-line if healthy.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) is officially active vs. Panthers after expected-to-play reports.
items.why: Calf injury; expected to go per sources; not on inactives.
items.implication: Full or near-full snap share expected; viable WR3/flex with Burden/Swift/Loveland competition.

items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) situation murky for SNF vs Cowboys; sounds up to him after full practices. Giants elevated Braxton Berrios and Dalen Cambre from PS. Main slate otherwise locked; projections updating live, no other major changes expected.
items.why: Knee (prior ACL context); full practice but personal decision; PS elevations as contingency.
items.implication: If out, Berrios/Cambre and other Giants WRs rise; if in, high upside WR1. Monitor warmups/inactives closely.
items.opportunity: If active: target share; if inactive: elevated secondary WRs.

items.text: Weekend status summary: Love (ankle) and Odunze (calf) expected to play; Kamara (knee) not expected; Josh Williams activated (Sean Tucker doubtful); Nabers (knee) no news yet. Projections live and updating.
items.why: Compiled beat/insider reports for main slate and SNF.
items.implication: Core inactive window locked for 1pm; Nabers remains SNF swing factor. Shows and projections live for last-minute.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL sprain) is not expected to play and is officially inactive vs. Lions despite full Friday practice; progressed faster than expected but game plan set for next week.
items.why: MCL sprain; full participant late week but not quite ready; sources confirm sit.
items.implication: Unchallenged lead role for Travis Etienne; Kendre Miller elevated as RB2; Etienne top-10 RB upside with passing downs.
items.opportunity: Etienne bulk carries + targets; Miller change-of-pace snaps.

items.text: Berry starting Jeremiyah Love everywhere as risk/reward RB2 now that active; believes activation signals confidence despite ankle.
items.why: Active status + limited practice ramp; Cardinals depth chart RB2 but volume opportunity.
items.implication: Flex/RB2 start with upside; monitor for limited touches early.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown no surgery needed on high ankle sprain but sidelined 4-6 weeks; officially placed on IR. Contrasts Garrett IR surgery path.
items.why: High ankle sprain; no surgery but multi-week recovery.
items.implication: NE WRs (Diggs etc.) and TEs see target bump ROS short-term; hold for midseason return.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Patriots pass-catchers.

items.text: Roughly all main-slate news locked; only potential major projection change is Nabers (Q knee). Live projections available for every player/game; three morning shows ahead of 1pm lock.
items.why: News cycle complete except SNF Nabers decision.
items.implication: Trust current ETR numbers for lineup locks; watch Nabers warmups.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs remains on Commissioner Exempt list; NFL could count time as served toward potential domestic violence suspension (CBA 6-game min possible).
items.why: Off-field matter; sources expect time served credit.
items.implication: Marshawn Lloyd or other GB RBs elevated short-term; monitor suspension length for ROS.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers OUT after meniscus trim Tuesday; realistic chance miss only one game and return Week 2 at Chargers. Team monitoring feel this week.
items.why: Meniscus procedure post-camp injury; short absence hoped.
items.implication: Michael Mayer primary beneficiary for targets/snaps vs MIA; short-term TE streamer.

items.text: Happy Hour (noon ET) covering Nabers decision, Jeremiyah Love, Cooper Rush impact (ATL QBs out), CAR RBs, MIN RB, Mahomes start/sit, Marshawn Lloyd expectations, JAX WRs.
items.why: Live last-call start/sit and status discussion.
items.implication: Per-player Love/Hate and waiver signals emerging from show; prioritize Love start and Hubbard flex.

items.text: Kamara's inactive status directly boosts projections for Travis Etienne and other Saints backs in high-pace NO-DET matchup.
items.why: Kamara out opens full backfield opportunity; Thorman notes elevated pace for NO-DET.
items.implication: Etienne RB1/high-end RB2 with volume spike; start confidently.
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, red-zone in up-tempo game.

items.text: Sean Tucker doubtful/inactive; Josh Williams activated for Bucs. Impacts TB backfield split with Bucky Irving/Kenny Gainwell.
items.implication: Irving/Gainwell committee clearer; both viable depending on game script vs CIN.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for Irving and Gainwell.

items.text: Ravens ruled out WR Ja'Kobi Lane due to wrist injury.
items.implication: Minor depth WR out; Flowers/Likely/Andrews primary unchanged.
items.opportunity: Slight target bump to other BAL WRs/TEs.

items.text: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. officially inactive (back) amid contract dispute; trade possibility remains in play.
items.why: Back injury + summer contract issues; sources confirm.
items.implication: Secondary impact for ATL-PIT matchup; limited direct fantasy unless IDP.

items.text: Rams DE Myles Garrett to IR after arthroscopic knee surgery; misses min 4 games (Giants, @Broncos, @Eagles, Bills). Hope back in 4 weeks; Aaron Donald possible return next MNF.
items.implication: Rams DL weakened short-term; IDP impact; offense (Nacua/Adams/Kyren) may face more pressure or different scripts.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is a viable flex this week; Berry 'keeping it open' on The Chubbler as flex play.
items.why: Solid role in CAR backfield vs CHI; volume floor.
items.implication: Viable FLEX option; monitor CAR RB committee signals from Happy Hour.

items.text: Thorman snaps & pace: NO @ DET up in pace; MIA @ LV slow-paced slog. Full Week 1 report available.
items.implication: Boost NO/DET skill players (Etienne, Gibbs, etc.); fade volume in MIA-LV (Achane/Jeanty/Bowers backups).
items.opportunity: Higher play volume NO-DET; lower MIA-LV.
